hooks.text: 随机楼层布局搭配50多把武器，让每次坠入兔子洞都形成不同路线
hooks.excerpt: Every run is different. Enjoy hours of replayable content through randomly generated floor layouts and 50+ weapons to collect and use.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 解锁6名玩法不同的角色，从不同视角重构同一轮回体验
hooks.excerpt: Unlock new characters with diverse playstyles. Each of the 6 unlockable characters keep gameplay fresh and give a unique perspective on the gameplay loop.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 收集书籍补全图书馆，拼出兔子洞未被看见的历史与主角自我真相
hooks.excerpt: Discover the truth that lies beneath the surface. Collect books and fill out your library to understand its unseen history. In the end, you may even come to understand yourself?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
